'''''Visit Pantora''''' was a travel advertisement for [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]],<ref name="Deception" /> the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]].<ref name="DBPantora">{{DB|species|pantoran|Pantoran}}</ref> It was put up on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], to attract visits from potential tourists. The [[Painting/Legends|poster]] showed the silhouette of a set of buildings against the [[Star/Legends|sun]], accompanied by the caption "VISIT PANTORA" written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]]. The advertisement graced the walls of the back room of [[Trueping's/Legends|Trueping's]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]],<ref name="Deception" /> and could also be seen aboard the [[Hovertrain/Legends|Coruscant train]].<ref name="Catch">{{TCW|To Catch a Jedi}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This poster was painted by ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' concept artist [[Randy Bantog]].<ref name="SW-Deception Trivia Gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/deception-trivia-gallery|text="Deception" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 4}}</ref>
